name: Diego Wernicke
bio:
Diego Wernicke is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in newschool, black&gray, and neotraditional styles, creating stunning and intricate designs that draw clients from all over. Operating out of Storm the Gates in Varsity Lakes, Diego's professionalism is reflected in both the immaculate quality of his work and the clean, well-maintained environment he ensures for every client. For an exceptional ink experience that meets the highest standards of the craft, Diego Wernicke is the artist to trust.
